hypothesis: Change only the reference point of global pheromone evaporation from zero to the original positive base trail: before applying the unchanged deposits, update every adaptive trail as tau_base + (1 - evaporation_rate) * (tau_previous - tau_base). Learned excess pheromone still decays at the Parent's rate, while an unreinforced corpus-supported action retains base support instead of becoming practically unreachable.
method_thesis: Extract a task-agnostic action alphabet of sanitized, attachment-labelled fragments and compatible attachment statistics from the allowed unlabeled corpus, retaining no whole corpus molecule as a candidate. In each independent objective session, initialize a fresh Ant System pheromone table over start-fragment, attachment-transition, and stop decisions, and seed it with deterministic fragment traces of the ten fixed scored starting molecules. For every evaluator-announced batch, independent ants begin from an empty graph and repeatedly sample valence-compatible construction actions with probability proportional to task-local pheromone times the fixed corpus-frequency heuristic, producing variable-length molecular graphs that are canonicalized and locally resampled until the returned batch is novel, valid, and unique. After oracle feedback, evaporate the global trail table and let every accepted construction deposit rank-weighted pheromone on exactly the components it used. This score-driven stigmergic memory recombines useful fragment transitions into fresh molecules without fitting a surrogate, retrieving or ranking a finite molecular pool, or enumerating a fixed candidate set. Trail statistics are mechanism evidence only; success is the equal-weight mean of the five independent terminal Top-1 scores.

applicability_conditions: The prepared attachment grammar contains useful alternatives beyond the trails already rewarded; retaining support cannot reach chemistry absent from the fixed 320-fragment grammar or its compatibility map.
Positive rank-weighted deposits keep learned trails at or above the base so evaporation toward BASE_PHEROMONE decays only learned excess and never reverses the oracle preference ordering by itself.

Enough feasible decision sets contain both deposited and never-deposited trails for restored support to alter sampling during the 29 adaptive colonies; a fully reinforced or nearly deterministic feasible set offers little leverage.

The objective benefits from continued exploration or has deceptive and multimodal component credit. On a smooth objective whose early reinforced components are reliably optimal, retaining more prior support may slow exploitation.

The unchanged local retry bounds have enough capacity to turn the broader action distribution into ten valid novel terminals; otherwise extra exploratory support can be consumed by locally rejected constructions.

Terminal score ranks remain informative for the Parent's shared component deposits. This intervention limits support collapse but does not correct context-misleading credit among components that are all frequently reinforced.
Evidence for the bottleneck is limited to seed 0, so multi-seed score reliability remains to be established by this paired Child evaluation.

research_intent.observed_bottleneck: Parent n-356b49b2b57a applies every adaptive evaporation as a multiplicative decay toward zero before adding positive rank-weighted deposits. After 29 updates, an unreinforced trail fell from 1.0 to 0.003166662062502754 while task maxima reached 249.17440419607505 to 480.5581570370605; final normalized trail entropy was only 0.30326063755775384 to 0.4106099197150958 and coefficient of variation was 14.95084526227372 to 23.158767630953857. This self-reinforcing loss of support coincided with 674 completed constructions colliding with already evaluated molecules, and median_2 made no Top-1 improvement at all. The limiting behavior is premature suppression of corpus-supported alternatives, not failed feedback or proposal validity: all 13,491 eligible decisions were displaced by deposits, every colony filled, and every evaluator submission was valid and unique.

research_intent.mechanism: Change only the reference point of global pheromone evaporation from zero to the original positive base trail: before applying the unchanged deposits, update every adaptive trail as tau_base + (1 - evaporation_rate) * (tau_previous - tau_base). Learned excess pheromone still decays at the Parent's rate, while an unreinforced corpus-supported action retains base support instead of becoming practically unreachable.

After 29 updates, an unreinforced trail fell from 1.0 to 0.003166662062502754 while task maxima reached 249.17440419607505 to 480.5581570370605; final normalized trail entropy was only 0.30326063755775384 to 0.4106099197150958 and coefficient of variation was 14.95084526227372 to 23.158767630953857. This self-reinforcing loss of support coincided with 674 completed constructions colliding with already evaluated molecules, and median_2 made no Top-1 improvement at all. The limiting behavior is premature suppression of corpus-supported alternatives, not failed feedback or proposal validity: all 13,491 eligible decisions were displaced by deposits, every colony filled, and every evaluator submission was valid and unique.
